title: Send OTel traces to OTLP endpoint
body:
Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019ed0a7-db54-7242-98ee-5a16cbf08b00

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes the ingestion path for all default OTel trace traffic; misconfigured `/otlp` or response handling could drop or mis-process spans, though queue retry behavior on failure is unchanged.
> 
> **Overview**
> OpenTelemetry trace export no longer uses the generic table insert API when the monitoring client is configured with **`table: "traces"`** (the default for `registerOTel` / `RawTreeTraceExporter`). Batched rows are sent with **`sendOtlpTraces`** to **`POST /otlp`** instead of **`POST /v1/tables/traces`**. Other tables still use **`insert`** unchanged.
> 
> The SDK adds **`OtlpTraceResponse`** (optional **`partialSuccess`** with rejected span counts / error message) and a **`RawTree.sendOtlpTraces`** helper that mirrors **`insert`** (JSON body, same auth/headers). Tests assert the OTLP URL for SDK calls and for the full **`registerOTel`** span flush path.
>
